name: Extended Cube Architecture for Arbitrary Parallel Projection
definition: A special-purpose computer architecture for volume visualization that enables arbitrary parallel projection in O(n^2 log n) time, extending the original Cube architecture which only supported orthographic projection.
summary: The Extended Cube Architecture enables real-time arbitrary parallel projection of volumetric data by using a 2D Skewed Buffer and Ray Projection Tree to handle non-orthographic views without pre-processing.
